balanced-lease.title: Cedar Lane Residential Lease
paragraphs: This synthetic residential rental agreement is between fictional landlord Avery Reed and fictional tenant Morgan Vale for 12 Cedar Lane, Example Town.
The lease starts on January 1, 2027 and ends on December 31, 2027. Monthly rent is USD 1500.00. The security deposit is USD 1500.00.
The lease does not renew automatically. Any extension requires a new agreement signed by both parties.
The tenant may terminate early by paying a fee equal to one month's rent. Remaining rent for the unused term is not due.
The security deposit is refundable. It will be returned within 14 calendar days after actual move-out, less documented damage beyond ordinary wear. Deductions are limited to those documented costs.
A one-time late fee of 3 percent of monthly rent applies after a grace period of 5 calendar days. Late fees do not accrue daily.
Rent increases are not permitted during this lease term.
The landlord may terminate only for a stated breach and must give 30 calendar days of notice. Termination without cause is not permitted.
Tenant liability is limited to damage caused by the tenant. It excludes landlord negligence, structural repairs, and ordinary wear.
All persons, addresses, amounts, and terms in this document are fictional. This document is provided only for software demonstration.

renewal-trap.title: Willow Court Residential Lease
paragraphs: This synthetic residential rental agreement is between fictional landlord Rowan Lake and fictional tenant Casey Fern for 9 Willow Court, Example Town.
The lease starts on April 1, 2027 and ends on March 31, 2028. Monthly rent is USD 1800.00. The security deposit is USD 4500.00.
This lease automatically renews for a further twelve months unless the tenant gives written notice at least 75 calendar days before the contract end date.
Early termination is prohibited. If the tenant leaves before the term ends, all remaining rent for the full lease term is immediately due.
The security deposit is nonrefundable. The landlord may also deduct any amount at the landlord's unrestricted discretion.
Late payment attracts a daily fee of 2 percent of monthly rent. The grace period is zero calendar days, and the fee accrues daily until payment.
Rent increases are allowed every 6 months with no cap on the increase. The first increase takes effect on October 1, 2027.
The landlord may terminate without cause on 5 calendar days of notice.
Tenant liability is unlimited and includes the landlord's negligence, all structural repairs, and ordinary wear.
All persons, addresses, amounts, and terms are fictional. These intentionally unfavorable terms illustrate a software demo, not a legal assessment.

The deposit is refundable. The return period and permitted deductions have not been specified.
